battle.name: 第一次英緬戰爭
battle.theater: 阿薩姆與伊洛瓦底河中游
battle.brief: 一八二三年三月，緬軍逐走英方駐阿薩姆的代表，衝突升級；一八二四年三月東印度公司三路出兵：孟加拉縱隊越帕特凱山口、馬德拉斯縱隊由海路奇襲仰光，英軍線列步兵以燧發槍列陣齊射，野砲配火箭攻破達貢木柵與彬烏城，最後逼出阿瓦的《楊達波條約》，英軍未入緬甸王都。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 交戰一方是英國東印度公司的聯軍，另一方是緬甸雍籍牙王朝（康東）王國。公司一側由加爾各答的總督參謀會議統籌，總督阿默斯特於一八二三年秋批准出兵；部隊分屬孟加拉軍與馬德拉斯軍兩套建制，混合英王直屬的皇家團與歐洲步兵營，以及公司僱用的孟加拉、馬德拉斯、貝恩庫爾等地土邦步兵（sepoy）大隊，後者是此役的人數主力。指揮上，孟加拉縱隊歸坎貝爾中將，馬德拉斯縱隊歸希斯洛普中將，阿蘭克方向另派一支小縱隊；海上由東印度艦隊分遣隊與皇家海軍陸戰隊提供船隻、灘頭火力與淺吃水砲艇，負責伊洛瓦底江與薩爾溫江的河道運輸。緬甸一方是王都阿瓦的中央軍隊，由國王直接調度，北方戰線由王儲敏豪·摩訶班杜拉指揮；緬軍以按戶徵集（史載大約十戶一兵）的方式組成連隊，配象兵、戰船、火藥作坊與自鑄銅砲，並在阿薩姆、卡查爾與欽敦江一線部署前線部隊。戰事實際在西北邊界與南部沿江同時展開：孟加拉縱隊在阿薩姆方向，馬德拉斯縱隊在伊洛瓦底江下游與仰光，兩路之間是緬甸腹地與欽敦江的空白地帶。
countriesEn: The opposing sides were the combined forces of the British East India Company and the Konbaung (Burmese) kingdom. On the Company side the supreme government at Calcutta directed the campaign, and the Governor-General Lord Amherst authorised the invasion in the autumn of 1823. The troops belonged to two separate establishments, the Bengal Army and the Madras Army, mixed with crown regiments and European infantry companies and with the Company's own sepoy battalions recruited in Bengal, Madras and Bencool, which supplied the greater part of the rank and file. At command level the Bengal column was led by Major-General Sir Archibald Campbell, the Madras column by Major-General Sir Thomas Hislop, and a small third column operated out of Arakan; at sea the East Indies station of the Royal Navy provided shipping, landing fire and shallow-draft gunboats to work the Irrawaddy and the Salween. On the Burmese side stood the central army of the capital Ava, dispatched directly by the king, with the northern front commanded by the crown prince Maha Bandula. The Burmese army was raised by household conscription, a system recorded as roughly one man from every ten households, organised into companies, and supported by war elephants, river flotillas, powder manufactories and locally cast bronze cannon, while forward bodies of men were stationed along Assam, Cachar and the Chindwin. In practice the war ran at once on two widely separated fronts: the Bengal column in the Assam direction and the Madras column in the lower Irrawaddy around Rangoon, with the empty interior of Burma and the Chindwin lying between them.
people: 英方最關鍵的人物是東印度公司總督阿默斯特，他在加爾各答拍板用兵，並於一八二四年十二月親至仰光，正值英軍攻擊達貢（Dagon，即仰光）大木柵受挫之際，其塘報與事後追責成為倫敦議會的焦點。實際統兵者為坎貝爾中將，他率孟加拉縱隊越過帕特凱山口、再解耶特吉（Yenangyaung）之圍，並在一八二五至一八二六年率軍沿伊洛瓦底河北上；馬德拉斯縱隊由希斯洛普中將率領，是五月十二日奇襲仰光後登陸作戰的主力。萊佛士當時任貝恩庫爾副總督，是公司內部最積極主張對緬用兵、並推動通商條約的人。伯尼家族亦在前線：亨利·伯尼中尉一八二四年四月在耶特吉被摩訶班杜拉大軍圍困，查理士·伯尼上尉則率不足八百人的分遣隊奇襲仰光得手。緬甸方面，國王巴吉道在阿瓦主持和談並任命使節，實戰主要由王儲摩訶班杜拉負責；他在一八二四年於北線屢挫英軍鋒頭，一八二五年又率大軍西征暹羅，抽走緬甸兵力，使英方得以在中部集中兵力。
peopleEn: Among the British the decisive figure was Lord Amherst, Governor-General of the East India Company, who authorised the war at Calcutta and who was personally at Rangoon in December 1824 at the very moment the storming of the Dagon stockade was failing; his dispatches and the later accounting of failure became the focus of debate in Parliament. The actual command was Campbell's: he led the Bengal column over the Patkai passes, relieved Yenangyaung, and in 1825 and 1826 marched north up the Irrawaddy, while the Madras column was commanded by Sir Thomas Hislop and formed the main body that campaigned ashore after the coup de main of 12 May. Raffles, then Lieutenant-Governor of Bencool, was the most forceful advocate inside the Company of war against Burma and of a commercial treaty. The Burneys also appear at the front: Lieutenant Henry Burney was shut up at Yenangyaung by Maha Bandula's army in April 1824, while Captain Charles Burney carried off the surprise attack on Rangoon with fewer than eight hundred men. On the Burmese side the king, Bagyidaw, negotiated at Ava and appointed envoys, while the fighting was directed by the crown prince Maha Bandula, who checked British columns in the north in 1824 and who in 1825 marched west against Siam, drawing Burmese troops away and allowing the British to concentrate in the centre.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是英軍線列步兵一七一〇年代起列裝的燧發滑膛步槍，即通稱「褐色貝絲」的 .577 寸口徑燧發槍：木托、附通條的鐵槍管、燧石擊錘與火藥壺藥盤，槍管約一米一，全槍重四公斤出頭，裝藥約四打蘭，配六十四克上下的圓彈，槍口裝刺刀；火繩式早已退位。牠在體系裡的位置是全軍的標準制式步槍：公司土邦步兵與英王直屬團的線列步兵都以它為主兵器，受訓射手的射速（約每分鐘三發）、三排密集的齊射與刺刀衝鋒，都靠這件火器撐住。相對地，緬軍主力是各式火繩槍、長矛與盾牌的混成，槍械口徑與火藥品質不齊，遠射精度遜於英軍，但人數與近身衝鋒仍具壓力；緬軍亦有自鑄銅砲與少量繳獲的英軍火炮，另有象兵、戰船與火藥作坊承擔火力與補給。輔助兵器方面，英軍有六磅、九磅、十二磅野砲與臼砲、海軍艦炮、康格里夫火箭與河上淺吃水砲艇；後勤靠牛車、象隊與船隻。需要說清的是，此役的火砲才是攻城與壓制的主力，燧發槍的作用是讓線列步兵在遠程上壓住緬軍前排，為砲兵與工程兵鋪路，而不是獨力攻破木柵。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the flintlock smoothbore musket with which British line infantry were armed from the 1710s, the .577-inch arm known as the Brown Bess: a wooden stock, a barrel with a ramrod, a flintlock with frizzen and pan, a powder horn and a ball box, a barrel about 1.1 metres long and a whole weight a little over four kilograms, charged with roughly four drams of powder and a ball of about sixty-four grams, with a fixed bayonet. The matchlock had long been displaced. Its place in the system was that of the standard regulation musket: the Company's sepoy battalions and the crown regiments fought with it as their principal arm, and the rate of fire of trained musketeers, about three rounds the minute, the volleys delivered from a close formation, and the advance with the bayonet all rested on this weapon. By contrast the Burmese were armed with a mixture of matchlocks, spears and shields; the calibres and the quality of their powder were uneven and their shooting at long range fell short of the British, though their numbers and their close assault still carried weight. They also had locally cast bronze guns and a few captured British pieces, with war elephants, river craft and powder manufactories carrying their firepower and their supply. In support the British fielded six-, nine- and twelve-pounder guns, howitzers, naval cannon, Congreve rockets and river gunboats, with bullock carts, elephant trains and boats for transport. It should be said plainly that the artillery, not the musket, was the instrument of siege and of massed fire: the flintlock musket's function was to hold the Burmese front down at long range and to open the way for the guns and the engineers, not to break a stockade on its own.
tactics: 英軍的戰術骨架是線列步兵的三排密集射擊與縱隊齊射，輔以「砲隨步兵」的火砲分組。一八二四年三月三路同時推進：孟加拉縱隊自阿薩姆翻越帕特凱山口，沿山道壓向耶特吉；馬德拉斯縱隊由海路北進，五月十二日以一支不足八百人的分遣隊奇襲仰光得手，主力隨後在雨季逼近前倉促築柵，試圖以火砲與火箭攻破達貢大木柵。十二月的攻擊失敗暴露兩個問題：攻具不足，且沒有攻城砲列——守軍以木柵、壕溝與火炮構成的三角堡壘，並非野砲可以正面對付。英軍遂退到安達曼海側度過雨季，一八二五年再來時已由海船卸下海軍重砲組成攻城砲列，並配合火箭隊與登陸部隊，先取達貢木柵，再於彬烏（Pagan，今勃固）城下築圍攻壘。向上的攻勢靠艦炮與河上砲艇沿伊洛瓦底江節節推進，配合小股飛縱隊奪取阿瓦城外的孟延、達耶兩座要塞，砲火與封鎖同時壓向王都；後勤線經加爾各答與孟買走海路，再由船隻與河運輸送糧食、火藥與攻城器材，季風決定每一季能推進多遠。緬軍則以縱深防守配合側擊：北部以大軍拖住英軍，南部以木柵與河流遲滯英軍，並趁英軍集中於中路時在欽敦江與若開一線反攻。
tacticsEn: The British tactical framework was the three-rank close-order volley of the line infantry, supported by batteries kept with their infantry. In March 1824 three columns advanced at once: the Bengal column came out of Assam over the Patkai passes and pressed down the road towards Yenangyaung; the Madras column moved north by sea, and on 12 May a detachment of fewer than eight hundred men carried Rangoon by surprise, the main body coming ashore afterwards and, with the monsoon closing in, hastily throwing up lines and trying to break the great Dagon stockade with field guns and rockets. The failure of the December attack exposed two faults: the assault lacked engineer stores, and there was no siege train, for the Burmese defences, a timber stockade ringed with a ditch and served by cannon, could not be beaten frontally by field guns alone. The British withdrew to the Andaman side of the estuary to wait out the rains, and when they returned in 1825 they brought naval heavy guns landed from ships to form a siege train, working with rocket troops and landing parties to take the Dagon stockade first and then to invest Pagan. The advance northward was made by naval guns and river gunboats working up the Irrawaddy step by step, with small flying columns seizing Myingyan and Thayettaw, the forts outside Ava, while guns and blockade pressed on the capital. Supply ran from Calcutta and Bombay by sea and was then carried inland by boat and by river, in provisions, powder and siege stores, and the monsoon decided how far the army could advance in each season. The Burmese answered with defence in depth and counterstroke: the north was held by large armies to pin the British, the south was slowed by stockades and rivers, and counterattacks were launched in the Chindwin and Arakan lines while the British were concentrated in the centre.
data: 兵力數字各方記載相差很大，只能取其大略。一八二四年首輪入緬的英軍，一般記為一萬至一萬三千人，分孟加拉縱隊約六千人、配野砲十二門，馬德拉斯縱隊約九千人、配野砲三十門，阿蘭克方向的小縱隊約兩千人；一八二五至一八二六年增援與土邦民兵湧入後，總數被記到接近兩萬。火炮方面，除野砲外另有海軍艦炮與臼砲登陸，攻城砲列的規模遠超一八二四年。單場戰役的對比最能說明差距：一八二四年四月耶特吉被圍時，英方援軍約一千至一千五百人，摩訶班杜拉大軍的數字從一萬到兩萬都有記載；達貢木柵的守軍記為四五千人，備有火炮十數門，而英軍攻柵失利一役的傷亡，記錄在數百人上下。全役英軍陣亡與受傷合計，通行說法是一千五百上下，但官方公報與私人記述並不一致。距離與時間：加爾各答至仰光海路約一千三百公里，仰光至阿瓦順伊洛瓦底江約九百五十公里；一八二四年三月出師，至一八二六年二月二十四日訂立條約，歷時約二十三個月，其中大半時間因雨季與季風被迫停戰。火藥一項，緬方以自辦火藥廠維持供應，品質與產量都不及英方，這也是英軍在火力密度上佔優的根源之一。
dataEn: The strength figures disagree widely in the sources and can only be given in rough outline. The first British entry of 1824 is generally put at between ten and thirteen thousand men, divided into a Bengal column of about six thousand with twelve field guns, a Madras column of about nine thousand with thirty field guns, and a small column of some two thousand men in the Arakan direction; with reinforcements and Company levies in 1825 and 1826 the total is recorded at close to twenty thousand. In guns there were naval pieces and howitzers landed in addition to the field artillery, and the siege train of 1825 was on a far greater scale than anything attempted in 1824. The contrast in a single action shows the gap best: at Yenangyaung in April 1824 the British relief force numbered about a thousand to fifteen hundred men against a Burmese army variously given as ten or twenty thousand; the garrison of the Dagon stockade is credited with four or five thousand men and a dozen or more cannon, while British casualties in the failed assault are recorded in the several hundreds. For the whole war the British dead and wounded together are usually put at around fifteen hundred, though official returns and private narratives do not agree. Distance and time: Calcutta to Rangoon is some thirteen hundred kilometres by sea and Rangoon to Ava about nine hundred and fifty kilometres up the Irrawaddy; the expedition left in March 1824 and the treaty was signed on 24 February 1826, a span of some twenty-three months, much of it spent halted by the rains and the monsoon. On powder, the Burmese maintained their own manufactories, with quality and output both behind the British, which was one root of the British advantage in density of fire.
cause: 開火有直接與深層兩重原因。直接原因在西北邊界：十八世紀末以來雍籍牙王朝一路北進，先後吞併撫密諸邦，一八二一年至一八二二年大軍進入阿洪（阿薩姆）地區，殺害公司派駐的官員與隨員；阿洪國王向加爾各達求援，公司於一八二三年派一名代表前往斂旋，緬軍要求其離境，代表退出後，衝突責任被雙方各執一詞，一八二三年遂被列為戰爭的起點。深層原因則是公司西北邊疆政策與緬甸王國擴張的正面碰撞：公司希望以孟加拉為基地打通往雲南與中國的商路，萊佛士等一批官員認為只有在緬甸境內建立穩定據點，才能同時保住貿易與邊界；而雍籍牙王朝的北上，同樣是為了壓制阿洪、孟加拉與孟加拉灣方向的反制勢力。此外，東印度公司在一八二二年已嘗試以通商條約的名義向緬甸施壓，未果之後便轉向軍事，於一八二三年秋取得倫敦授權，一八二四年春動手。
causeEn: There were immediate and underlying causes. The immediate one lay on the north-west frontier. Since the late eighteenth century the Konbaung dynasty had pushed steadily north, absorbing the Shan states in turn and entering the Ahom country of Assam in 1821 and 1822, where Company officers and their followers were killed; the Ahom king called upon Calcutta for help, and in 1823 the Company sent a representative to negotiate, whereupon the Burmese demanded his withdrawal. After he left, each side held the other responsible, and 1823 is consequently entered as the opening of the war. The underlying cause was the collision between Company frontier policy in the north-west and Burmese expansion. The Company wanted Bengal as a base for the trade road towards Yunnan and China, and men such as Raffles argued that a firm footing inside Burma was the only way to hold both trade and frontier, while the northward movement of Ava was intended to check the countervailing power of Assam, Bengal and the Bay of Bengal. Pressure had already been applied in 1822 under cover of a commercial treaty; when that failed the Company turned to arms, obtained authority from London in the autumn of 1823, and struck in the spring of 1824.
impact: 這場戰爭把緬甸從上緬強權推成英國的附庸。割地、賠款、常駐代表與通商條約四項一併加身：緬王保住阿瓦與正統，卻失去阿薩姆、卡查爾、欽敦江地區與若開，連同南部出海走廊；從此公司可以在仰光設港、在孟加拉辦廠，直接接上安達曼海與孟加拉灣的航線。對英國而言，這是東印度公司在亞洲最大的一次勝利之一，也是印度土邦步兵第一次成建制遠征並在數百公里外連續作戰，直接推高了後來英軍介入尼泊爾、邏散與馬來半島的底氣。對緬甸而言，割地與賠款動搖國庫，王室的正統由盛轉衰，但雍籍牙王朝並未崩潰，反而把注意力轉向暹羅、馬來半島與克倫地區，在其後二十年裡仍維持南亞細亞強權的地位。英國介入緬甸的長期格局亦在此役定調：代表駐紮、條約文本與砲兵介入三者結合，二十六年後的第二次英緬戰爭正是沿同一條裂痕撕開。
impactEn: The war pushed Burma from the position of a strong power in Upper Burma into that of a British dependent. Cession, indemnity, a permanent resident and a commercial treaty were fastened on it together: the king kept Ava and his legitimacy but lost Assam, Cachar, the Chindwin country and Arakan, together with the whole seaward corridor of the south; the Company could thereafter establish a port at Rangoon, run its factories in Bengal and sit directly on the routes of the Andaman Sea and the Bay of Bengal. For Britain this was one of the greatest victories the East India Company won in Asia, and the first time that sepoy battalions campaigned in formed divisions and fought continuously hundreds of kilometres from their depots; it fed the confidence behind later British intervention in Nepal, in Loon and in the Malay Peninsula. For Burma the cession and the indemnity strained the treasury and turned the dynasty's ascendancy into decline, yet the Konbaung state did not collapse: it turned its attention to Siam, the Malay Peninsula and the Karen country, and remained the dominant power of the south-east Asian mainland for the twenty years that followed. The long-term pattern of British engagement with Burma was settled at this point, in a resident at court, a treaty text and an artillery presence; the Second Anglo-Burmese War, twenty-six years later, was to open along the same fault.
result: 一八二六年二月二十四日，公司代表與緬甸使節在阿瓦以南的楊達波村簽訂條約，戰事至此結束。條約主要內容是：緬甸放棄阿薩姆、卡查爾與欽敦江地區，承認撫密諸邦與克倫地區的獨立並接受英方保護，不得再對吉哈、曼尼普爾一帶的主權提出主張；割讓若開的沿海據點，並交出德林加土、摩塔班等南部海岸區；支付一筆分期償付的賠款（金額與期限史載不一，此處不列確數）；在阿瓦常駐英國代表；開放仰光等港口供英國商人通商，並允許英方派駐官員。英軍沒有攻入阿瓦城，也沒有扶植傀儡國王，國王巴吉道與王儲摩訶班杜拉仍在位，公司取得的是地盤、賠款與條約權力。王儲摩訶班杜拉其後在對暹戰線上陣亡（一八二六年），公司趁南線空虛再取南側據點，兩場戰爭的成果最終以這紙條約的地理條款寫定。
resultEn: On 24 February 1826 the Company's representatives and the Burmese envoys signed a treaty at the village of Yandabo south of Ava, and the war was over. Its terms were chiefly these: Burma renounced Assam, Cachar and the Chindwin country, recognised the independence of the Shan states and the Karen country and accepted British protection over them, and made no further claim to Jiribam, Manipur and the lands around it; it ceded the coastal outposts of Arakan and gave up Dawei, Mergui, Martaban and the southern coast; it agreed to pay an indemnity by instalments, the amount and the term being variously reported and so not stated here precisely; it accepted a permanent British resident at Ava; it opened ports such as Rangoon to British trade and allowed Company officials to reside. The British never entered Ava and set up no puppet king: Bagyidaw and the crown prince Maha Bandula remained on their thrones, and what the Company took was territory, money and treaty rights. Maha Bandula was afterwards killed on the Siamese front in 1826, and the Company, finding the southern line empty, took the southern posts that same year; the gains of the two campaigns were fixed in the end by the territorial clauses of this paper.
